Episodes.Title: Passion Is Born
Episodes.Actors: Shin Eun-soo, Seo Hee-young, Chun Ho-jin
Episodes.Plot: Eun Gyeol and his family move into a new neighbourhood where he starts to learn the guitar. As he deals with bullies at school, he practices playing the guitar until he is as good as the man who taught him.

Episodes.Title: Eun Gyeol Quits Music
Episodes.Plot: Eun Gyeol find it very hard to quit music, he also gets his hands on the guitar promised by the Viva Music store owner.

Episodes.Title: Seoul 1995

Episodes.Plot: Eun Gyeol gets stuck in 1995 and he meets his father at his fathers young age who can talk and wants to start a band for a girl who isn't his mother.

Episodes.Title: Eun Gyeol Becomes Yi Chan's Tutor
Episodes.Actors: Seol In-ah, Shin Eun-soo, Kwon Dan-A
Episodes.Plot: Yi Chan tries to get away from Eun Gyeol, but Eun Gyeol follows him to the Snail Guesthouse and became Yi Chan's math tutor.

Episodes.Actors: Choi Hyun-wook, Seol In-ah, Shin Eun-soo
Episodes.Plot: Chung Ah wakes up and realizes that she's lying on a hospital bed, with the revelation that Yi Chan carried her there on his back. Later, Yi Chan learns her name from her tag for the first time.

Episodes.Plot: Eun Gyeol's attempts at self-defence resulted in Yi Chan with a bleeding nose on both sides. This made schoolyard into a battleground with more students intervening.

Episodes.Title: Another Time Traveller
Episodes.Actors: Shin Eun-soo, Seo Hee-young, Chun Ho-jin
Episodes.Plot: Eun Gyeol and Se Gyeong are time travelers from 2022. They each had a mission in 1995. Eun Gyeol discovers Chung Ah was confined and abused for 12 years. Se Gyeong reveals Yi Chan's accident hasn't happened yet.
